Happy to. Here's a fresh version, built around your three bullets:

Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for your Summer 2026 Supply Chain / Transportation Analyst Internship in the Bay Area. I enjoy turning messy operational data into decisions, and I'd like to do that with your team.

In a warehouse simulation project, I modeled the pick process and found changes that cut modeled pick time by 18%. I'd bring the same habit of measuring first and then adjusting to your analyst work.

At my campus career center front desk, I schedule appointments for 40+ students each week across a 10-hour shift schedule. That taught me to keep details straight, communicate clearly, and stay calm when plans change.

Through the supply chain club, I've kept up with how logistics teams think about cost, service and speed.

I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I can contribute this summer. Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
[your name]
